invariants.description: every site occupancy stays in [0, 1], and so does the open fraction P_RyR
Eq. A12 and A11: P_RyR = a (1 - i) l^N and j_RyR = k_RyR P_RyR (Ca_ER - Cai)
k_RyR = A_ER rho_RyR k_RyR_single 1e-18 m3/um3 (density x per-channel flux coefficient)
steady-state occupancies are the mass-action values kon C/(kon C + koff) (the Kds koff/kon: activating 200 uM at rest, inactivating 0.63 uM, luminal 130 uM)
invariants.expr: (np.max(np.abs(a_RyR_inf - kon_a_RyR*Cai/(kon_a_RyR*Cai + koff_a_RyR))) <= 1e-12) & (np.max(np.abs(i_RyR_inf - kon_i_RyR*Cai/(kon_i_RyR*Cai + koff_i_RyR))) <= 1e-12) & (np.max(np.abs(l_RyR_inf - kon_l_RyR*Ca_ER/(kon_l_RyR*Ca_ER + koff_l_RyR))) <= 1e-12)

invariants.description: the starting occupancies are the steady state at the starting Ca: a_RyR_init = kon_a Cai_init/(kon_a Cai_init + koff_a), i_RyR_init likewise, l_RyR_init = kon_l Ca_ER_init/(kon_l Ca_ER_init + koff_l)
each site state starts at its computed starting occupancy (run test only: in a parameter sweep the simulation keeps the starting state computed at the default parameters, see known_issues)
with Cai fixed, a_RyR relaxes exactly (Eq. A13 is linear in a): a_inf + (a_RyR_init - a_inf) exp(-t phi (kon_a Cai + koff_a))
with Cai fixed, i_RyR relaxes exactly (Eq. A14): i_inf + (i_RyR_init - i_inf) exp(-t phi (kon_i Cai + koff_i))
with Ca_ER fixed, l_RyR relaxes exactly (Eq. A15): l_inf + (l_RyR_init - l_inf) exp(-t phi (kon_l Ca_ER + koff_l))
flux direction: release j_RyR has the sign of Ca_ER - Cai (zero when they are equal)

bc_sweep.rationale: Factors 0.5-2 on every parameter. kon_a_RyR also covers the caffeine value: 5-20 /(mM s) around rest and 500 and 2500 /(mM s) (2500 = hernandezcruz1997ca's k_on+Caff, Kd 0.8 uM). Temperature: T is swept over 273.15-313.15 K (0-40 degC; the factors would give 148-590 K, where the Q10 factors are absurd); Q10s are bounded to 1-5, T_ref to 273.15-313.15 K and the initial occupancies to [0, 1].

baseline.reason: the source's own validation is its full diffusion model (cytosolic shells, buffers, pumps; Fig. 10-11), whose shell count and pump binding rates are not given in the paper, so its figures can't be reproduced by the RyR alone; the kinetic constants are the published ones (Fig. 10 legend). Validation belongs to the assembled neuron (soma / sympathetic neuron supermodule).

calibrate.note: not_applicable: the constants are hernandezcruz1997ca's published values; calibration of the flux magnitude (rho_RyR) belongs to the assembled neuron (soma / sympathetic neuron supermodule).
